Main text in one column: a short paragraph, two centred headings with a paragraph under each, and a further paragraph running on to the foot of the page. No margin notes. Nothing printed below the text.

main_text.p: Petro Thomasio, qui in Candia Pontificis Romani legatus erat, hæ-resefeωs condemnatum, conftater pœnam ignis perpessum esse: cum ce-teri, qui in eadem fuissent causa, quod erant professi, renuntiasset, anno M. CCCC. XC.
Idem scribit, eundem legatum offa cuiusdam mortui, post morte hæ-refeωs accusati, effodienda atque exhumanda curauisse.
main_text.head: MATER DOMINAE YONG.
main_text.p: D testimonium Euangelij illustrandum maximopere pertinet, quòd nullus sexus est prætermissus, quem Deus ad martyrium non vocauerit. Exempla multa præclaraque sunt hodie fidelissimarum fœminarum, quæ cum viris in hanc Euangelij communionem ac socie-tatem veniunt: vt cum eis multa grauia & opprobria & tormenta pa-tiantur. Sed olim in Anglia insignis & commemorabilis exempli fuit lestissima fœmina, dominæ Yongæ mater, quæ propter religionem vi-rili constantia virtuteque cremata est, anno M.CCCC.XC.
main_text.head: ROGERIVS DVLE.
main_text.p: ROgerius Dulus, homo nobili genere ortus & professione militari, pro vetitate defendenda & propugnanda in Anglia suspensus atque strangulatus fuit, anno M.CCCC.XC.

EX eo tempore verbum Dei maximum accepit incrementum, fru-ctusque admirabiles protulit. Nam Spiritus sanctus animos tum eorum qui doctrinam Euangelij annunciabant, tum etiam eorū qui au-diebant, ita feliciter tetigit, vt numerus fidelium ac piorum in dies sin-gulos vehementer augeretur. Huiusmodi autem virtus constantiaque diuinitus eis dabatur, vt quidā ex illis molestias & ærumnas carcerū, suma cum voluntate susciperent ac subirent: alij amissione bonorum æ-quo ferret animo: multi vero ne mortem quidem, eámque acerbā, per-timescerent. Ex quo facile intelligi potest, ac vere dici, persecutiones ecclesiæ Christianæ per Apostolos natæ, repetitas renouatásque fuis-se, Christūmque dominum eam operum admirabilem virtutem, quam primis illis temporibus exhibuit, his nostris quoque nouissimis exhi-buisse ac declarasse, cum tantam gratiam in mundū protulit atque effu-dit,

page.notes: The line-end hyphens in "fru-ctusque", "socie-tatem", "pa-tiantur" and the others are printed hyphens kept as printed. The ornamental initials "D" and "R" are woodcut/ornament letters: the "D" at the start of "Testimonium" and the "E" at "EX" are shown as printed. The word "vetitate" is printed as such (probably veritate); left as printed. "vt quidā" and "carcerū" keep the printed spellings. The final line "dit," is printed alone at the right and is the end of the paragraph's last word. Uncertain: the first word of the first line (at the top) is partly cut off in the scan; read as "Petro". The marginal "Angli." is a running head at the upper left, recorded as such.
